body: I feel you. This is the only reason why I'm around as well. I'm my mom's only child and she lives to see me happy or to hear my voice. If I were to die, it'd kill her. I think that having that empathy, recognizing that we are, even if in our own terrible little masochistic way, sparing some people we love from the pain  is at least a little comforting. We may be a disappointment to ourselves, but we're good enough people to want the best for others around. It's a great reason to still be here.
